Recipes DNase I treatment preparation Reagent Volume DNase I (1 U/µL) 5 µL DNA digestion buffer 75 µL These components are parts of Direct-zol TM RNA Miniprep kit. DNase I is provided as lyophilized powder. Reconstitute it using with DNase/RNase-Free Water. The volume of added water depends on the unit in DNase I powder to reach the final concentration of 1 U/µL. For example, add 250–275 µL water for 250 U of DNase I powder and 50–55 µL water for 50 U of DNase I powder. Mix well and then store the aliquots at -20 °C until use. steps.title: Expose mice to aerosol
steps.instruction: Place female C57BL/6 mice (6–8 weeks) in the InExpose chamber and expose them to JUUL mango, JUUL mint, or filtered air aerosol for 20 min three times daily (total 60 min/day) for 4–12 weeks (1–3 months). All procedures follow IACUC protocol S16021.

steps.title: Euthanize and dissect colon
steps.instruction: Euthanize mice by regulated slow (~50 % CO₂ flow) inhalation followed by cervical dislocation. Using scissors and forceps, cut the whole colon from the anus to the cecum.

steps.title: Rinse, clean, and store colon
steps.instruction: Place the colon in a Petri dish with PBS, rinse to remove blood, trim attached adipose tissue, swab out remaining stool, cut into small pieces, and transfer a piece into a 1.5 mL tube containing 400–500 µL RNAlater (optional: increase to 600 µL‑1 mL for larger pieces). Store at –80 °C. (If RNA extraction is performed the same day, RNAlater step can be omitted.)

steps.title: Prepare tissue for homogenization
steps.instruction: Thaw colon pieces on ice, wash briefly with PBS, weigh each piece (≤20 mg; ideal 5–20 mg), and place the piece into a 1.5 mL tube containing 600 µL TRI reagent (increase to 800 µL for tough tissue).

steps.title: Homogenize tissue in TRI reagent
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue with a handheld homogenizer for 1–2 min at the middle speed until no visible fragments remain. Clean the homogenizer between samples with 70 % ethanol and water.

steps.title: Centrifuge homogenate and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 13 000 × g for 2 min. Transfer the clear supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube; discard the pellet.

steps.title: Add ethanol and bind RNA to column
steps.instruction: Mix the supernatant with an equal volume of 95–100 % ethanol (≈600 µL). Load the mixture onto a Zymo‑Spin IICR column (capacity 700 µL) and repeat the loading once more on the same column to accommodate the total ≈1 200 µL volume.

steps.title: Centrifuge column and discard flow‑through
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 13 000 × g for 1 min. Discard the flow‑through (it can be saved for protein purification) into a 15 or 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Wash column with RNA wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL RNA wash buffer (provided with the Direct‑zol kit) to the column, centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 30 s–1 min, discard flow‑through, and transfer the column to a new collection tube.

steps.title: DNase I on‑column treatment
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL DNase I treatment preparation (5 µL DNase I (1 U/µL) + 75 µL DNA digestion buffer) to the column and incubate at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Pre‑wash column twice
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Direct‑zol RNA PreWash buffer to the column, centrifuge 13 000 × g for 1 min, discard flow‑through, and repeat the wash once more.

steps.title: Wash column with RNA wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL RNA wash buffer to the column, centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 1 min, then spin the empty column in a new collection tube at 13 000 × g for 5 min to remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Elute RNA from column
steps.instruction: Place the column in an RNase‑free tube, add 50 µL RNase/DNase‑free water directly onto the matrix, incubate at room temperature for 2–5 min, centrifuge 13 000 × g for 1 min, collect eluate, and repeat the elution once more (second 50 µL addition, 2 min incubation, 1 min spin).

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA from RNA
steps.instruction: In a thin‑walled 0.2 mL PCR tube on ice, combine 4 µL 5× qScript reaction mix, RNA containing 500–750 ng (volume adjusted to reach 20 µL total) and nuclease‑free water to 20 µL. Vortex gently, spin 10 s, and place in a MiniAmp Plus thermal cycler with the program: 25 °C 5 min, 42 °C 30 min, 85 °C 5 min, hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Dilute and store cDNA
steps.instruction: Dilute the cDNA 1/5 or 1/10 with nuclease‑free water and store the diluted cDNA at –20 °C until qPCR analysis.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: For each 10 µL reaction add: 5 µL 2× SYBR Green qPCR Master Mix (including ROX as per manufacturer), 1 µL cDNA (containing 50–100 ng), 1 µL forward primer (4 µM, final 0.4 µM), 1 µL reverse primer (4 µM, final 0.4 µM), and 1 µL nuclease‑free water. Dispense reactions into a MicroAmp optical 96‑well plate, seal with GPLE adhesive covers.

steps.title: Run qPCR program
steps.instruction: Place the plate in the qPCR instrument and run: Hold 95 °C 10 min; 40 cycles of 95 °C 15 s, 60 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; Melt curve: 95 °C 15 s, 60 °C 60 s, 95 °C 15 s.
